h1: Content pipelines from idea to draft to publish
overview: Content stalls when nobody knows whose turn it is. We build a pipeline in the tool you already use, such as Notion, Airtable, Trello or Google Sheets. An idea becomes a brief, then a draft prepared with AI help, then a review by your editor, then a scheduled post. Each card shows its owner and deadline, and nothing is published until a person marks it approved.

faq: Which tools can the pipeline live in?
Notion, Airtable, Trello, Asana and Google Sheets all work well. Pick the one your team already opens every day so the pipeline actually gets used.
Will the drafts sound like my brand?
We add your voice notes and a few sample pieces you like into the drafting instructions. Drafts are a starting point that an editor reviews, not a finished article.
Only to a scheduled state. A person marks the item approved first, and the tool then queues it. We do not set up posting that skips human review.
Do you write the content too?
This service builds the system. If you also want articles or posts written, order a content service from us separately and we feed it through your new pipeline.
